blocks.text: The arrival of the glory of the God of Israel at the east-facing gate (vv. 1-5) is set against Ezekiel’s earlier vision of that glory departing from the defiled temple and city in chapters 8–11. Chapter 43 therefore presents the glory’s entrance into the visionary sanctuary as a return. The larger vision of chapters 40–48 continues beyond this scene with a measured sanctuary, its altar and ministers, offerings, land, river, tribes, resident aliens, and a city named YHWH-shammah.
